name: FSL Brain Extraction (BET) on T2
summary: Removes non-brain tissue from a T2-weighted image with FSL BET (robust centre estimation) and outputs the skull-stripped image and its binary brain mask.
description: Runs FSL bet with -R -m on the T2-weighted image using the chosen fractional intensity threshold. Use it before registration or analyses that need a skull-stripped T2w image. The output keeps all other files of the input datatype and replaces the image with the masked one. Inspect the mask: if too much or too little brain is removed, adjust fthreshold.

outputs.description: The brainmask of the T2w image

parameters.description: choose the fractional intensity threshold (0 -> 1); default=0.2; smaller values give larger brain outline estimates
